reviews.text: Great service, they're friendly and take great care of the pets. I recommend them.

To the owner of this establishment, I need a full copy of full blood panel. What was done to my cat , I have yet heard from you I would be advise to give me results as I requested please and thank you.
Very reasonable. They are the best...
Dr. A and his staff were knowledgeable, friendly, efficient and honest. My pet is feeling so much better after our visit. Thank you so much for giving us a same day appointment.
I took my puppy for his vaccinations and preventative medication. In my experience this is an affordable clinic for routine health check and preventative medicine. The clinic is an affordable option.
Awesome place love everyone thank God for them Good people :)

Very nice staff amd vetinarian despite it being busy we had a good experience the vet and vet tech were very nice with my dog. Very thankful they saw him. I will continue to go there for all his vetinarian needs. Thank you
This is by far the best veterinary care I ever received. The doctor was beyond amazing and the staff were so caring . This will be my forever clinic

Came here for the 1st time. Doctor was in & out quickly but it was my 1st time ever coming to a vet visit for a cat, so I figured "what do I know?" ....  2 days later I took my cat to the groomer. They said that she had fleas all over her butt/tail area & there is no reason why the vet should not have discovered this. Kind of scary that they cannot spot something on the fur/skin level. How can they be trusted to find a virus, sickness or disease?
Excellent customer service, friendly staff, and doctors that care.
Saw my animal fast and received fast results.

We live about an hour away and were going to be later than 5pm. They understandably weren't able to guarantee we'd be seen if we made the drive, but we decided to take a chance and go anyway.

The staff was very kind and friendly and quickly earned Wally's trust. He didn't cry or flinch during his vaccines and stayed surprisingly calm throughout the visit. Satish Perikala was efficient without making us feel rushed. He took the time to answer my questions, had a calm and reassuring demeanor, and made Wally feel at ease.

We were in and out quickly, the prices were lower than many other clinics I looked at, and the walk-in availability was convenient.

I will definitely be back. Thank you for a great experience! 🐾

Fast, efficient and easy check up and vaccines for our frenchie.  Thank you to the friendly staff members that made the appointment a great experience.  Thanks to Dr. Perikala for listening and answering my questions and concern and approving our prescriptions so quickly.  Highly recommend

I was able to bring my dogs in without a appointment for vaccines and didn't have to wait long at all. You have to pay for a exam to vaccines, but the vet was thorough and answered all my questions. I will definitely be back. The staff is very kind and I felt like they were more focused on the most affordable options best suited for your wallet and your pet.
Great service walk ins. Reasonable prices. Cheaper than other local vet clinics.

This clinic is great! I have two kittens (6 weeks) who had worms and we came here and got successfully treated. I was worried they would need to go to the emergency room, but they eased my nerves and knew how to help. All of their staff was very nice and informative. My animals and I felt very safe here. The packages they offer are very well priced, and the clinic is very quick and efficient. We are excited to come back!

The Doctor that helped my poor baby was super understanding and I love how receptionist  understood that I brought in his brother because he has anxiety and did not judge me like other clinics do. Also very affordable vs his last vet clinic and they take care credit too! I’m happy I moved back! I will be taking my other cats for extra care here🐱

The best vet and staff I have had in Houston. I am a native and 78 years old. I have always had animals cats and dogs. The staff is extremely supportive and very knowledgeable.
The doctor understands your pet immediately
Then they discuss every charge you may have
To incur .
Melanie Evans
Great vet and provides the best care. Highly recommend.
Super friendly service at a reasonable price.I will come back.

Their prices are definitely reasonable and the Doctors are very attentive and kind. The only reason I didn't rate 5 stars is because I witnessed two of the staff members (one in particular) treat/talk to the white lady at the front in ways that aren't appropriate for the work place. Even When in the exam room I could hear them in the back trash talking her. I'm sure they think people in the rooms can't hear but that one girl with the glasses voice carries. Wait until you get home to be a mean girl. It's unprofessional to treat your coworkers in that way even if you don't like them.

I love this place!
Affordable prices and they are very professional and caring with pets 🥰
Great place to come if you are looking for reasonable prices

🎰🎰🎰🎰🎰

Very practical, local animal clinic.

Good staff, good prices for vet exam.
$35 (tax included) 11.2025

I am so glad that I went this place at the first try. Jack pot!

Recommend especially if you adopt a pet like me and your adoption place requires vet exam document, this is where to go.

WARNING!!! If you love your dogs, please do not take them to PET CHECK.  Today we took our senior dog to get something checked out in her mouth. She has arthritis and has stiff legs.  I do not think, I've ever heard my dog SCREAM that way. The man that was drawing the blood was huffing and puffin for some reason. The vet said he was an expert at what he does.  He might be, but had no patience for a senior dog.  Just like senior people you have to handle with care. They DID NOT.
Pet check had nothing to say about it but oh well, right?!?!? Animals are like our children. If your child screamed bloody murder you would run to see what was going on, same in this case.  I will NEVER bring my animals here.  Cheaper isnt always better!! Beware please.
A modest veterinary clinic with people who actually care. I feel that this is a place that you can trust for your animals.
This place is a no frills clinic. No appointments, just walk in. The wait is about 5-10 minutes. The doctors really care about your pet.

I honestly don’t know why it’s taken me this long to write a review because PetCheck has been nothing but amazing in the 8 years we’ve been coming here!  They’ve cared for all my dogs and cats. every visit reminds me why I trust them so much. The vet always listens, never rushes me, and even when I’m stressed or in panic mode, they take the time to explain everything and calm me down.
Most importantly I love that they truly care about the animals, not just the money. Other vets have given me the runaround or tried to charge me thousands, but not here. They’re compassionate and work with my budget and still keeps my pets healthy and happy. My pets love the vets assistants and they always shower my pets with love!
They’re affordable, honest, and compassionate and I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else. I make sure all friends and family bring their pets here and they can second this! Thank you Petcheck our fur family couldn’t do it without you please never change!
They are awesome!

I do not recommend coming here if your pet has any complex issues going on. I come here for sick appointments and just feel rushed out. I feel like them being walk in only makes them way too busy to have time to care. I think they should just stay a vaccine clinic only. I did not like that they don’t place catheters in surgery patients, doctors don’t talk to you after the surgery either. My cat had an underlying condition that was flaring up her mammary glands. They told us to get her spayed and never gave me any plan or helped me with what to do next. They also don’t call you the next day to see how your animals doing either again I just think they’re way too busy being a walk-in clinic to do the things that make you feel like they actually care. But, they are fine as a vaccine clinic only like I said. And yes I know they are “low cost” so you get what you pay for. I ended up taking my cat to an aaha accredited clinic instead to fix her other underlying condition and was worth every penny.

I arrived on Friday and waited two minutes for someone to come and greet me. The girl sitting across from me, wearing glasses, was on her phone. She didn't look up at me; she just yelled for someone to speak in Spanish. Every time I come in, she does the same thing, and I don't think it's right to have someone like that at reception. I keep coming when I need something for my dog ​​and because the doctors and the staff at El Cuarto are very kind, but the girl across from me, the one with the glasses, always gives us an annoyed look when we walk in.
Easy & Affordable! Rachel at the front desk is awesome! Both Doctors  are great however, my go to is, Dr. Satish Perikala D.V.M., M.S Thanks for all that you do ! :-)
fast service and love that they work with local animal rescues
Great service front vet and tec
Friendly staff. Quick to check our dog. Clearly explained everything for care & treatment. Reasonable with pricing especially compared to other veterinary clinics nearby in Spring Branch.

Arrived today during open hours only to be told that they had a busy day and are closed for lunch for an hour. None of this was posted to let customers know of their closing hours. No consideration to the customer.  Not to mention I was told they usually close from 1-2 and it’s 1:50pm. Tip: Post your closed lunch hours on google and stick to those hours!!
The vet was fablous...the staff is incompetent they can't even operate a printer machine.
My #1 go to

I brought my senior dog here about 3 months ago she had a mass tumor/cyst and 1 of the things I saw the doctor did and I did not like was while he was explaining to us what it could be with not warning like a heads up he insurted a long needle into her tumor/cyst , after he did that he claimed it was fat .. I felt uncomfortable because like I said it was a long needle and my poor dog had her ball red and it was a mid size ball so I’m pretty sure that hurt her .
2 the vet techs are not good at informing you  when they give you the medications what they are for also they didn’t mention what I was paying for it was more of a “ok let’s get you to pay and that’s it “ they just mentioned the total and that’s it . Usually when I took my dog to her old vet they would always always mention the medication given and why and how . At this location I did not receive enough information I should’ve .
The doctor and staff were nice , I would just say the doctor needs to be a little more gentle and carrying about the pups especially since we are the one talking for the dogs because they can’t talk they can’t tell us it hurts or anything so I would be a little more careful.
Also if the staff could be more informed on what’s happening when ready to be checked out . I’m not 100% blaming this clinic but after the doc had prescribed her antibiotics for I’m guessing due to the mass she had , she started behaving differently .. so we immediately stopped giving her the  antibiotics .. then may my senior baby girly rest in peace ..she started having very bad epilepsy. After her 3 we had to put her down due to she was having more then 1 epilepsy a day she had 3 epilepsy in 1 week .
She wasn’t 100% good when we took her to the vet .. but after the vet she got worst ..instead of getting better . She wasn’t eating she had no appetite .. less peeing … less pooping.. she wouldn’t sleep .. I mean she was doing really bad .. we took her to this vet January 10th and she died on February 22…
Please discuss the medications before letting the customers walk out the door.
When I went to the grand mission pet check due to my dogs eyes were slightly red around her pupils .. they were trying to give me even more medication another antibiotics when they had already prescribed her antibiotics. I asked them if the medication (antibiotics)would intervene with the antibiotics I was giving her that the doctor prescribed basically if it would be bad , they said nope .. but of course I wasn’t going to even risk it .. so I just got the eye drops .
For anyone in the future that’s brings there pup to a doc please double check ask all questions about what your paying for and what’s given to you and for what so what happened to me won’t happen to you .

I showed up at 1:30 PM and the clinic was already closed even though their posted hours say they close at 2. Super frustrating, especially when you’re trying to take care of your pet and count on their hours being accurate. If you’re going to close early, at least update your hours or put up a sign. Not professional at all.
Excellent service, they attended me super fast, very friendly and very professional.
Efficient and attentive.

Petcheck animal clinic is a nice place to do interviews at , they make sure you feel welcome and the doctors are sweet and friendly, always caring for your pets need . Everyone in the clinic cares about your pets and they always make sure your animals are doing well during recoveries from surgeries. I definitely recommend coming back with my fur babies

Visited the petcheck clinic today and the staff & the vet were extremely patient and caring. My lab is beyond skiddish when it comes to going to the vet but they were so wonderful with him. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for treating him so kindly.

I haven't been inside the clinic, however, I called them twice today to get an intestinal parasites prevention for my brother's foster dog.

First time I called and explained that I saw tapeworms in his poop. I was starting the process of deworming him, but he would need a prevention that covers tapeworms. Since Trifexis doesn't cover tapeworms. I was told that he would need to come in for a heartworm and fecal testing since they only gave my brother one dose of Trifexis.

I understand policies, however, he had a heartworm test and the Trifexis dose at their clinic in December. If he had heartworm, the test wouldn't show positive until June-July. I started the Panacur process so a fecal would also be mostly negative by time he comes in.

I ask what type of prevention, they had in clinic and she gave me the generic name not the brand name. Called back to see prescription send out policy, they said had $10 fee to send out. I am going to my clinic later this week for an exam and prescription.

I had an amazing experience at Pet Check Animal Clinic! From start to finish, the entire team took such great care of my dog during his dental cleaning. Rosa and Desire did a fantastic job with the cleaning. I also really appreciate Rachel and Megan at the front desk for being so kind, organized, and helpful throughout the whole process. The team kept me informed every step of the way, and my dog recovered quickly with no issues. I highly recommend Pet Check for anyone looking for a caring and professional vet team. Thank you all so much!

If I could give this clinic zero stars, I would. I have been bringing my pets to Petcheck since 2016 for affordable vaccines. The staff and doctor have always been pleasant. While I did save money over the years, just remember that ultimately you get what you pay for. At my last visit, I requested a heart worm test, fecal test, and three vaccines. Instead of the requested vaccines, they gave my 14 lb dog six vaccines. The vet never confirmed which vaccines he was giving my dog. He came into the exam room and spent less than ten minutes with us, just enough time to give the vaccines and complete the tests.  Six hours later, I was bringing my dog to the emergency vet because she had an allergic reaction. The emergency vet said that my dog should have never received that many vaccines due to her size and weight.  It took about 24 hours for the swelling and itching to subside. The clinic has not assumed any responsibility and simply said “the extra vaccines will not hurt her” and “dogs sometimes have reactions.”  I will never return.

I have been going here for years. It is the best walk in with no appt vet service with very reasonable prices and quick service. The staff is nice and the Vet is kind and clear with what your pet needs to get better and stay healthy.

I just wanted to say thank you for helping my dog, the staff showed immense care and attention to him when he needed it throughout his appointments. he passed in november, but I know we all felt that pet check had been the most helpful and caring they could be for my little dog!!!

PET check was recommended to me and at first I was a little nervous because of the reviews and due to the fact that my dog has cancer and  is needle reactive.  However, I am so glad I used them because the receptions were nice, the vet tech was patient and knowledgeable on how to work with reactive dogs.  The best part was the vet, he did not rush the process and most importantly he was so kind to Bandit and very knowledgeable.  He made me feel at ease knowing that Bandit was in good hands. This is truly a vet clinic that loves what they do and cares about your pet! I will definitely come back and recommend them to everyone I know .

I’ve taken my cat there for emergency, 3 times. I’ve had the same experience all 3 times. Great staff, fast service, reasonable prices and my pet has had great results all 3 times. I highly recommend this location.
Also easy to get in and out and they do a great job for basic pet checkup services.

Terrible place to take your pet for vaccinations. They will force you to pay a higher price for vaccinations that you declined and put your pet in harms way by double vaccinations . They just rush the process and don’t listen to you as a customer. They also will not approve Bravecto delivery requests (ex. 1-800 petmeds) as they want to make you come in person (during their inconvenient hours, which they often close earlier than posted) or charge an extra fee for the prescription request, even if your pet has been seen by their vet. Please take your money elsewhere if you love your pet!

The entire staff are very caring and attentive. We have a cat who can be very temperamental. The technician, as well as the veterinarian, were very patient and loving through the entire appointment. The hours are very convenient and the prices are very affordable.

They are very nice, little to no wait time, walk ins are welcome (call to verify the hours bc it’s only certain hours like 10-12 and 2-5 or something like that). Their prices are very reasonable as well. Definitely recommend them and will be using their services again 🙏

Kitties are doing well ❤️
I would avoid this location if you can. Receptionist are always rude and the vet too booked to take you in.
Completely affordable, amazing and knowledgeable staff, the doctor is very thorough and we’ll definitely be returning. So grateful to have found this clinic
Great vet and staff

Came with my dog who’s older for some vaccines and heatworm test. Had a pleasant experience with the 2 techs Lynette and Syeda in the room one was a student  who handled my baby with care even though she was learning I had no problem my dog loved her and the other tech very much.
Best shot prices

Been going there for years. Went today for one of my older dogs. I've always liked them , today was different however and one of their staff was very unfriendly. She trimmed his nails and they were bleeding and they didn't do anything about it like before they had some power they put on them. He bled all a the way home and it was over 3 hours ago he is still bleeding so that I had to crate him. The assistant was rude and did a bad job. After over 5 years going there I can honestly say I will never go again. I will drive further and pay more than to take any one of my cats or dogs there.

🙏🙏🙏
Thank you …

Dr. Perikala saved my baby Tuti! He knew she was in trouble with her bladder stones and was able to quickly get her into surgery. This is now our new vet and I like that it’s a walk-in service. Very knowledgeable and accommodating! Thank you!

Dr. Sadesh was so sweet and helpful! (I hope I spelled his name correctly). He provided a lot of solutions to get my pup feeling better. I liked how I didn’t need to make an appointment but was able to get in immediately as they accept walk ins. Being from another city this was extremely helpful since it was last minute. He was truly a sweet Vet, thank you for caring 🩵 Alex & Pongo
Very nice staff and very affordable

Petcheck gives me hope in humanity. I don’t even know where to begin to express how incredible this clinic is. I know I can’t save every animal, but having the opportunity to take an animal to an affordable vet is such a blessing. It gives people the opportunity to provide great care to a fur baby that cannot advocate for itself. Beyond grateful to have this clinic in the heart of spring branch.

A good and affordable walk in pet clinic, took care of my dog without setting an appt or anything, i only had to go in and give them my phone number, i waited like 25 minutes before they called to tell me they were ready for me, the Dr and the nurse were nice, Rachel and the ladies in the front desk as well did a very good job, i recommend this place to everyone has a dog.
Great staff, wonderful Doctors and great prices.
